provenance.post_title: PACG Cutting Room Floor: Wondrous Rod
provenance.asset_description: Before acting against a boon or bane, freely recharge to roll 1d4: 1. Add 1d8-1 to checks against that card. 2. Draw 1d4-1 cards. 3. Heal 1d4-1 cards. 4. If the card is a story bane, evade it; if it is another type of bane or a boon, banish it and encounter a new card of the same type.
